description: List comments in a workspace. Filter by `target_type` (row, cell, doc_range, html_element, surface, workspace), `target_id`, `surface` (returns every comment anchored to any element of one surface, useful for 'open threads on this surface'), `status` (open | resolved | all, default open), `mentioning_me: true` for comments that @-mention the caller, or `author: <principalId>` for comments by a specific user/agent. Returns up to 200 comments per call ordered by `createdAt` asc, with `surfaceSlug` denormalized for doc_range/html_element/surface targets so reply paths work even across archive boundaries. Use `get_comment_thread` to pull a single comment plus its replies + reactions.

author.description: Filter by author principal id. Useful for 'comments by Argus on this workspace' agent loops.

mentioning_me.description: When true, only return comments that @-mention the calling principal. Equivalent to REST `?mentioning=me`.

offset.description: Number of comments to skip for pagination.

surface.description: Surface slug filter. Returns every comment anchored anywhere inside this surface (doc_range / html_element / surface scope, plus row + cell comments on rows that live on the surface). 404 silently if the surface is archived (returns empty list).

target_id.description: Filter by exact target id. For cells the id is `<rowId>:<columnKey>`; for doc_range/html_element/surface it's the Surface cuid. Combine with target_type for unambiguous filtering.

name: list_comments
